name: AdvancedLighting3D
description: Clustered forward dynamic lighting, baked light-probe GI, cascaded Sun shadows, and Signed Distance Field raymarched soft shadows for GDevelop 5 (Three.js WebGL2). Streams up to 512 registered Point, Spot, or Area Capsule lights through data textures, with a default 256-light budget and a 64-light limit per screen/depth cluster. Includes Karis representative-point area specular reflections, blackbody Kelvin colors, IES photometric distributions, Frostbite windowed attenuation, dedicated Lightflickereffects presets, and independent LightTweens transitions. A LightProbeVolume3D supplies baked indirect light. AdvancedShadowManager3D decides who shadows the scene and how the Sun casts. Performance depends on light overlap, shadow settings, cascade settings, SDF resolution, scene geometry, and target hardware.
shortDescription: Clustered dynamic lighting, baked light-probe GI, polished CSM Sun shadows, and static SDF soft shadows.
author: Twillion

eventsBasedBehaviors.name: ClusteredLight3D
eventsBasedBehaviors.description: Adds high-performance clustered dynamic lighting to a 3D object (Point, Spot, or Area Capsule) with Karis area specular, Frostbite falloff, blackbody Kelvin temperature, IES photometric profiles. Add Lightflickereffects to animate this light.

propertyDescriptors.name: LightType
propertyDescriptors.label: Light Type
propertyDescriptors.description: Emission geometry: Point, Spot, or AreaCapsule.

propertyDescriptors.name: Intensity
propertyDescriptors.label: Base Intensity
propertyDescriptors.description: Base radiant intensity multiplier. GDevelop 3D is pixel-scale and Radius is in METRES, so a value of 1 spreads almost no light over a 12 m reach and looks like the light is broken. Around 25 is a visible starting point.

propertyDescriptors.name: Radius
propertyDescriptors.label: Attenuation Radius
propertyDescriptors.description: Maximum reach in METRES; the runtime converts at 100 world units per metre, so 12 m is 1200 units. Attenuation hits exactly zero at this distance, so anything beyond it is unlit. Lowering it is the main performance lever (see the README), but raise it rather than lose the light.

propertyDescriptors.name: CapsuleLength
propertyDescriptors.label: Capsule Length
propertyDescriptors.description: Length of the neon tube / area bar in METRES (AreaCapsule only). 2 m is 200 world units.

propertyDescriptors.name: SpotInnerAngle
propertyDescriptors.label: Spot Inner Angle
propertyDescriptors.description: Inner cone cutoff in degrees (Spot only).

propertyDescriptors.name: SpotOuterAngle
propertyDescriptors.label: Spot Outer Angle
propertyDescriptors.description: Outer cone soft penumbra in degrees (Spot only).

propertyDescriptors.name: ColorMode
propertyDescriptors.label: Color Mode
propertyDescriptors.description: Color definition method: Kelvin blackbody or direct RGB.

propertyDescriptors.name: ColorTemperature
propertyDescriptors.label: Color Temperature (K)
propertyDescriptors.description: Blackbody temperature in Kelvin (1000K - 12000K).

propertyDescriptors.name: LightColor
propertyDescriptors.label: Light Color (RGB)
propertyDescriptors.description: Direct RGB color when Color Mode is RGB.

propertyDescriptors.name: EmissiveBoost
propertyDescriptors.label: Emissive Boost
propertyDescriptors.description: Over-bright multiplier for glow/bloom.

propertyDescriptors.name: IESProfile
propertyDescriptors.label: IES Profile
propertyDescriptors.description: Architectural photometric profile.

propertyDescriptors.name: CastShadows
propertyDescriptors.label: Cast Shadows
propertyDescriptors.description: Master switch for this light casting shadows, by whichever method Shadow Technique and the scene Shadow mode select. Off means no shadow from this light regardless of every other setting.

propertyDescriptors.name: SourceRadius
propertyDescriptors.label: Light Source Radius
propertyDescriptors.description: Physical light source radius for penumbra calculation (in world units, 0 uses 5% of light radius).

propertyDescriptors.name: ShadowBias
propertyDescriptors.label: Shadow Bias
propertyDescriptors.description: Normal offset bias to prevent self-shadow acne.

propertyDescriptors.name: ShadowTechnique
propertyDescriptors.label: Shadow Technique
propertyDescriptors.description: How this light casts. Auto lets the budget decide and falls back to the SDF if it does not win a shadow-map slot. ShadowMap always takes a slot, reserved ahead of Auto lights. SDF always marches the baked volume (static casters only, needs an SDFVolume3D). None lights without shadowing. Anything but SDF needs the scene shadow ownership to be Auto. Spot and Point lights can take a shadow map; AreaCapsule cannot and always uses the SDF. A POINT light costs roughly SIX times a spot, because its shadow is six cube faces rather than one map.

propertyDescriptors.name: ShadowMapSize
propertyDescriptors.label: Shadow Map Size
propertyDescriptors.description: Depth map resolution for this light. 1024 is about 4 MB; 512 is often indistinguishable for a spot covering a small area.

propertyDescriptors.name: ShadowMapBias
propertyDescriptors.label: Shadow Map Bias
propertyDescriptors.description: Depth bias for the shadow-map path, in clip space. Negative values pull the comparison towards the light. Distinct from Shadow Bias, which is in SDF voxel units.

propertyDescriptors.name: ShadowNormalBias
propertyDescriptors.label: Shadow Map Normal Bias
propertyDescriptors.description: Offsets the lookup along the surface normal, in world units. Raise it if you see shadow acne; too much detaches the shadow from its caster.

propertyDescriptors.name: ShadowMapNear
propertyDescriptors.label: Shadow Map Near Plane
propertyDescriptors.description: Light-space near plane in world units. 0 derives it from the light reach (far/50), which is almost always what you want: a near plane that is too small burns all the depth precision and no shadow appears at all.

propertyDescriptors.name: ShadowMapStatic
propertyDescriptors.label: Shadow Map Never Changes
propertyDescriptors.description: Promises nothing inside this light will ever move, so its map renders once and is never refreshed. Free, but a broken promise leaves the shadow frozen where the caster used to be.

eventsFunctions.name: ExplainShadow
eventsFunctions.fullName: Explain this light shadow in the console
eventsFunctions.sentence: Explain why _PARAM0_ does or does not cast a shadow
eventsFunctions.description: Logs whether this light is casting and, if not, exactly which check failed. Checks in order: light active, intensity above zero, Cast Shadows on, scene ownership is Auto, technique permits it, a shadow-map slot was won, something that CASTS is in range, something that RECEIVES is in range, and the distance field exists, is baked and contains the caster.

Safe to compare in events; the wording of the readable message may change but these codes will not.

eventsBasedBehaviors.name: AdvancedShadowManager3D
eventsBasedBehaviors.description: One optional manager per scene, and the single place scene-wide shadow settings live. Pick the method with Shadow mode, then tune it below: CSM settings drive the Sun, SDF settings the baked distance field, Maps settings the per-light depth maps. Per-light overrides stay on ClusteredLight3D.

propertyDescriptors.name: ShadowMode
propertyDescriptors.label: Shadow ownership
propertyDescriptors.description: WHO shadows this scene. Leave this on Auto unless you have a reason not to. Auto = this extension shadows the scene and each light gets the best method its Shadow Technique and the budget allow. Off = no shadows at all, including the native Sun. Native = shadowing is left entirely to GDevelop: this extension touches no shadow state, so the engine 3D lights and the Shadow casting / Shadow receiving checkboxes behave exactly as they would without it, while clustered lighting, probes and flicker keep running. Pick Native to combine clustered lighting with stock GDevelop shadows. To change HOW things shadow rather than who does it, use Sun shadow method below and the Shadow Technique property on each light.

propertyDescriptors.name: SunShadowMethod
propertyDescriptors.label: Sun shadow method
propertyDescriptors.description: How the native Sun casts, independent of how local lights do. Cascades = cascaded shadow maps that follow the camera and handle moving casters. DistanceField = march the baked volume instead; cheaper and softer, but static casters only and it needs an SDFVolume3D. Off = leave the Sun unshadowed while local lights still cast.

propertyDescriptors.name: CascadeCount
propertyDescriptors.label: CSM: Cascade count
propertyDescriptors.description: Cascade count

propertyDescriptors.name: MaxDistance
propertyDescriptors.label: CSM: Maximum distance in world units
propertyDescriptors.description: Maximum distance in world units

propertyDescriptors.name: SplitLambda
propertyDescriptors.label: CSM: Logarithmic split blend (0 to 1)
propertyDescriptors.description: Logarithmic split blend (0 to 1)

propertyDescriptors.name: ShadowMapSize
propertyDescriptors.label: CSM: Shadow map size (1024, 2048 or 4096)
propertyDescriptors.description: Shadow map size (1024, 2048 or 4096)

propertyDescriptors.name: SeamBlendWidth
propertyDescriptors.label: CSM: Cascade blend fraction (0 to 0.25)
propertyDescriptors.description: Cascade blend fraction (0 to 0.25)

propertyDescriptors.name: Softness
propertyDescriptors.label: CSM: PCF filter radius
propertyDescriptors.description: PCF filter radius

propertyDescriptors.name: ConstantBias
propertyDescriptors.label: CSM: Depth bias
propertyDescriptors.description: Depth bias.

propertyDescriptors.name: NormalBias
propertyDescriptors.label: CSM: Normal bias
propertyDescriptors.description: World-space normal bias.

propertyDescriptors.name: SDFBoundsMode
propertyDescriptors.label: SDF: Bounds mode
propertyDescriptors.description: Where the baked distance field gets its bounds. Explicit (default) uses only an SDFVolume3D behavior you place yourself. AutoScene fits a box around the shadow-casting and shadow-receiving geometry automatically, so you never have to place one - but only use it on a COMPACT scene. Fitted across a large level the fixed grid resolution gives voxels tens of units across, and the bake conservatively treats everything within half a voxel diagonal of a surface as solid, so the whole ground inside the box reads as an occluder and the lit area goes black. An SDFVolume3D you place always wins over the automatic fit.

propertyDescriptors.name: SDFAutoPadding
propertyDescriptors.label: SDF: Auto bounds padding
propertyDescriptors.description: World units added around the fitted geometry in AutoScene mode. Shadows need a little room beyond the objects themselves.

propertyDescriptors.name: SDFMaxAutoExtent
propertyDescriptors.label: SDF: Max auto extent
propertyDescriptors.description: Longest side, in world units, that AutoScene will fit. Beyond this the grid resolution is spread so thin that voxels grow larger than the props and the shadows are worse than none, so it refuses and says so instead of baking something useless. Raise it only if you accept the resolution loss.

propertyDescriptors.name: LocalShadowBackend
propertyDescriptors.label: Maps: Depth renderer
propertyDescriptors.description: Who renders the local shadow maps. Native borrows the Three.js shadow pass through a hidden zero-intensity light per slot, which costs TWO fragment texture units per shadowed light and recompiles every material in the scene whenever the shadowed-light count changes. Owned renders the depth maps directly instead: one texture unit per light, no recompile. Owned is newer and currently handles spot lights only - point lights fall back to Native automatically. Try Owned if you hit a black screen with a texture-units error in the console.

propertyDescriptors.name: MaxShadowedLights
propertyDescriptors.label: SDF: Max shadowed lights
propertyDescriptors.description: How many clustered lights may raymarch the distance field at once. Beyond this they still light the scene but stop casting.

propertyDescriptors.name: PointShadowDistance
propertyDescriptors.label: SDF: Max ray distance
propertyDescriptors.description: Longest an SDF shadow ray will travel, in world units. Caps cost for large lights.

propertyDescriptors.name: SDFSunSoftness
propertyDescriptors.label: SDF: Sun softness (degrees)
propertyDescriptors.description: Angular softness of the directional Sun shadow when Sun shadow method is DistanceField.

propertyDescriptors.name: SDFHitEps
propertyDescriptors.label: SDF: Surface hit threshold
propertyDescriptors.description: How close the raymarch must get to count as a hit, in voxel-size units. Raise it if shadows shimmer.

propertyDescriptors.name: SDFNormalBias
propertyDescriptors.label: SDF: Sun normal bias
propertyDescriptors.description: Offsets the Sun ray along the surface normal, in voxel-size units, to stop self-shadow acne.

propertyDescriptors.name: MaxShadowMappedLights
propertyDescriptors.label: Maps: Max shadow-mapped lights
propertyDescriptors.description: Memory budget: how many clustered spot or point lights may hold a depth map (0-8). A 1024 spot map is about 4 MB; a point light stores six faces in one atlas and costs roughly six times as much to both store and render. Lights beyond this fall back to SDF, or go unshadowed if no baked volume is available.

propertyDescriptors.name: MaxShadowMapUpdatesPerFrame
propertyDescriptors.label: Maps: Max map updates per frame
propertyDescriptors.description: Time budget, separate from the memory budget: how many maps may RE-RENDER in one frame. A map only re-renders when something inside its light moved, so a static scene costs nothing.
